text.en:
1. This order may be cited as the Modification of Laws (Sedition) Citation.
(Extension to Sarawak) Order, 1969.

2. The Sedition Ordinance, 1948 is extended to Sarawak and shall Serres

have effect therein with the modifications set out in the Schedule.     fo Sd pawale

3. The Sedition Ordinance of Sarawak is heréby repealed.           Repeal
arawaok
Cap. 20.

SCHEDULE

(Article 2)

MODIFICATIONS TO BE MADE TO THE SEDITION ORDINANCE, 1948,
IN ITS APPLICATION TO SARAWAK

Section                                      Modification
6 (1)...      ... Insert after "Sabah" ", Sarawak".
7      58      ... Substitute for "the officer in charge of a police district"

"an administrative officer or to the officer in charge
of the nearest police station".

Made this 4th day of November, 1969.
[KHEDN. Y. 34/37; P.N. 3180 & MGN(PA) R. 21.11.]

Tunku Tan Sr1 MOHAMED BIN TUNKU Besar BURHANUDDIN,
Secretary to the Cabinet

(To be laid before each House of Parliament pursuant to section 74 (9)
of the Malaysia Act, 1963.)
